Since 0.1.0. The major version stays 0.

### Play
RetroArch plays games with its cores, saves, and RomM downloads (#247). It is filed with the emulators (#248). DS games use both screens again when the launch picks melonDS, including beside RetroArch's DS cores (#254).

### Home
A or X on a lit L1/R1 pill opens that drawer (#253). The Home strip ends at its last tile, so a slot emptied by Hide, Unpin, or Remove does not extend it (#251). Holds to delete a download or shortcut work again after Home (#252). The achievement list keeps its focus ring inside its scroll (#250). Each screen's background starts at its own moment (#249).

### Look
Icons are one family: flat symbols in the chrome, lit objects on the grid (#256). Themes take colours, style tokens, font, and sounds from Afterglow, and Afterglow declares every token the engine reads (#257).

Pull requests no longer receive release signing secrets. They assemble an unsigned release instead.

The release asset is `foldcade.apk`.

### Known issues
- Download progress is still an open gap. `ensureLocal` returns when the copy is ready and has no progress channel. https://github.com/predmore/foldcade/issues/11
- The Thor hardware checklist is open. A green emulator run is not a Thor pass. https://github.com/predmore/foldcade/issues/43
- GameNative's own library is not imported. Foldcade reads exported `.steam` files only. It does not read GameNative's private database. https://github.com/predmore/foldcade/issues/100
